how_formed.names: every company name was searched on the web with its home city on 2026-11-13 and no business of that name was found there; the rejected names are in the agent's report. Russian sole traders (ИП) carry a surname and initials only, as the shop's system writes them, so they name nobody; they were not searched.
how_formed.us_vin: 17 characters: the maker's real world manufacturer identifier (WMI), a five-character descriptor in that model's style (best effort, not taken from a decoding table), the correct check digit in position 9, the real model-year letter in position 10, a plant character, a random serial. A decoder will confirm maker, year and check digit; it may not confirm the model. A coincidence with a real vehicle is unlikely but cannot be excluded.
how_formed.ru_vin: 17 characters: the WMI of the plant that built the model for the Russian market (X96 ГАЗ, XTA LADA, XTT УАЗ, Z6F Ford Sollers, X7L Renault, Z94 Hyundai and Kia, XW8 Volkswagen and Škoda, VF7 Citroën), a descriptor in the maker's style, the model-year letter where the maker uses one, a random serial. No check digit: these makers do not use the North American one.
how_formed.us_plates: Tennessee's plates of the series issued since 2022, the county on a sticker and not in the serial. The cars a story names (fleets, named customers) are drawn from BRC-2190 to BRC-8000, serials that were never issued (Wikipedia, Vehicle registration plates of Tennessee, read 2026-11-13), so none can be on a real car. Background cars: ledger erp.vehicle.plates.
how_formed.ru_plates: format А123ВС + region, letters АВЕКМНОРСТУХ only; the region is that of the shop the customer uses: 73 and 173 (Ульяновская область) at main and east, 16, 116 and 716 (Татарстан) at west. Background cars: ledger erp.vehicle.plates. No unissued series was researched, so a plate may coincide with a real registration.
how_formed.phones_and_email: phones.md: English tier A (NPA-555-01XX); Russian mobiles in the reserve code 907, city numbers beginning with 1; e-mail under .example
